Wit; 2 Fire; Far (200 ft). Reload: needs an Interact Action to reload after each Strike. Let there be light: each flare sheds bright red light in a 50 ft (Medium) radius for 20 minutes unless put out. You can fire it as long as you have flares.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.140
